items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: Well, Andrew Kimball was playing bass, violin.

ctx.x: Remember who else was in the Robichaux band at that time?
Well, Andrew Kimball was playing bass, violin. I can't call his name right off the rear, but Robichaux, left-hand violin player.
